dataQualityNotes: OSM tagging check (2026-09-23): way 1229453929 'PUB Bukit Timah Waterworks' is tagged man_made=wastewater_plant although it is a drinking-water facility. It is the nearest 'plant' for SG2, SG7 and SG10, so their distance-to-wastewater-plant feature is too small. Left uncorrected on purpose: the pipeline uses OSM as it stands, and this shows how much the score depends on map quality.
Singapore has very little farmland, so 6 of 10 sites sit at the 5 km search cap for distance to farmland; that feature carries almost no information here.
The 25 km wastewater-plant search buffer reaches Johor (Malaysia) and the Riau Islands (Indonesia); plants there are included when they are the nearest.

Singapore's water reclamation plants are sealed facilities that discharge treated effluent to sea through deep tunnels, not into these canals, so the feature's assumed mechanism (a nearby plant discharging to the stream) may not hold at all.
